flags.title: Two ESL Challenger League rows lack a per-match HLTV page
flags.detail: HLTV's per-match URLs for ex-Keyd Stars vs Galorys and Zomblers vs Overtake Sector were not captured. Both fixtures were confirmed inside HLTV event 2635 (ESL Challenger League Season 52 Cup 3) and on bo3.gg; EGamersWorld did not list a two-sided line for either at capture time.
flags.action: Reviewer: open https://www.hltv.org/matches?event=2635 and add the per-match URLs.

flags.title: Hotspawn crowd vs market disagreement (largest gaps)
flags.detail: ex-Keyd Stars vs Galorys: crowd 86% ex-Keyd Stars vs Polymarket 33c/68c (market favours Galorys). HOTU vs Fnatic: crowd 91% Fnatic vs bc.game 1.93/1.83 (near coin-flip). MIBR vs BC.Game: crowd 70% BC.Game vs bc.game 1.64/2.20 (market favours MIBR). Gothic vs Lavked: crowd 90% Lavked and bc.game 1.881/1.782 (favours Lavked) vs Polymarket 53c/47c (favours Gothic).
flags.action: These are genuine source disagreements, not errors in this dataset. Both numbers are shown with links.

flags.title: Team-name aliases between sources
flags.detail: Hotspawn 'WROTBERRY' occupies the same fixture slots/times as HLTV/Polymarket 'WBT'; Hotspawn 'RoundsGG' corresponds to HLTV 'ROUNDS' and Polymarket 'RoundsGG'; Hotspawn 'EAC' appears on EGW as 'EA Copenhagen' and on Polymarket as 'Esport Academy Copenhagen'. Slot-for-slot correspondence is exact, but no official statement that WROTBERRY is WBT was captured.
flags.action: Reviewer: confirm the WROTBERRY / WBT identity before trusting the odds mapping for those 4 fixtures.

flags.title: FORZE Reload opponent mismatch in the prediction market
flags.detail: Hotspawn and HLTV both list FORZE Reload vs LFO 10 at 2026-10-14 13:00 UTC. Polymarket lists the same slot as 'FORZE Reload vs Sokerorg' (FORZE 95c / opponent 12c). Because the opponent identity does not match, the Polymarket price was NOT used for this row's line.
flags.action: Reviewer: confirm whether LFO 10 and Sokerorg are the same roster.

flags.title: Fixture team order differs between Hotspawn and HLTV
flags.detail: Hotspawn: RoundsGG vs Voca. HLTV: Voca vs ROUNDS. Polymarket: Voca vs RoundsGG. Prices were mapped by team name, not position.
flags.action: Reviewer: confirm home/away ordering does not affect the pick'em entry.

flags.title: EGamersWorld placeholder-looking odds
flags.detail: Several EGW match pages displayed identical 1.8 / 1.8 decimals for both teams (a pattern consistent with an unset/placeholder line, e.g. HAVU vs Rounds). These values were excluded; only the event-page 'Bets on ... by bc.game' module was used.
flags.action: Reviewer: spot-check those EGW match pages.

flags.title: Odds move between components and between captures
flags.detail: 9z vs Aurora was displayed as 3.3/1.26 (EGW match page), 3.6/1.27 (EGW event odds module) and 3.8/1.22 (EGW event schedule list). Falcons vs NiP showed 1.23/3.95 and 1.22/3.8. Every captured price in this dataset is a point-in-time snapshot, timestamped 2026-10-13.
flags.action: Reviewer: treat all prices as snapshots; re-pull before acting.

flags.title: Prediction-market spreads are wide on low-liquidity fixtures
flags.detail: Polymarket detail prices on several Elisa BreakOut Group B/A fixtures sum to 125-139 cents, indicating wide bid/ask and near-zero volume. Those prices were normalised before use and are marked low quality.
flags.action: Reviewer: prefer the bc.game line where both exist.

flags.title: Hotspawn pick percentages tick continuously
flags.detail: Captured crowd percentages moved between two snapshots 20 minutes apart (e.g. ex-Keyd Stars 83% -> 86%, Falcons 94% -> 89%). All displayed percentages are one snapshot and are never used in any probability.

flags.title: Coverage boundary: locked/completed matches are not in the table
flags.detail: The lobby's tournament filter counts 85-86 pool entries for the week ('60 matches this week'), while the lobby itself listed 26 open-for-picks fixtures at capture. Matches that had already locked/completed were not enumerated (they cannot be picked any more). Tournament-group counts are reproduced on the Tournaments page.
flags.action: Reviewer: say if completed matches should be back-filled as well.

flags.title: HLTV betting-analytics pages do not expose numeric odds to this pipeline
flags.detail: HLTV's '/betting/analytics/<id>/<slug>' pages render analytics (form, head-to-head, handicap distributions, map stats) but the numeric decimal odds table did not render as machine-readable text (values such as '1.23eOddset' appear to be parsing artefacts). HLTV figures were therefore used for verification/support only, not as a price source.

flags.title: League of Legends pick'em tab not covered
flags.detail: play.hotspawn.com/lol-pickems exists (per sitemap). This dataset covers the CS2 pick'em lobby only.
flags.action: Reviewer: say if LoL should be added.

flags.title: Pool-size counts differ between renders
flags.detail: The lobby filter showed 'All tiers (86), B (27), C (55), S (4)' in one render and 'All tiers (85), B (26), C (55), S (4)' minutes later (matches starting drop out of the pool).
